facts.fact: Corporal Kandan of Mathoor, past thirty with a scar through one brow, was Raiu's comrade; his mother Kalyani has been lame in the left leg since spring. He refuses to be 'known' by Neela and stays unwon.
facts.why: needed because the beat names Kandan as the man she cannot win

facts.fact: Garrison men Neela learns: Vasu (mother keeps ducks at Kalladi), Sankaran (mother returned to Neerattu), Kuttan (cannot write; Neela writes his mother a line). Fourteen men in the barracks at the noon meal.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Neela learn every man's name and his mother's village

facts.fact: Neela keeps her barracks name list in chalk on a broken roof tile, modelled on Asha's slate; Devan sees it and nods once.
facts.why: needed to show Asha's method without Neela taking Asha's actual slate

facts.fact: Neela has walked round the west stair newel since her first days at Kettamala, before Raiu died, and cannot say why; she blames Raiu only afterwards. The fort's talk says Devan bowed to Rema at Ittan's execution.
facts.why: needed to set up the reader question about her body avoiding the stair

facts.fact: The eleventh step of the west stair rings hollow; at the side of the stair, low in the wall, is an iron drain grate with file-bright bolts and no rust, newer than the stair by years. The long way up is the east stair and wall-walk, eighty-one steps by Neela's count.
facts.why: needed for clues C12 and C13
